changelog:
Super Browser Automation v1.0.0 – Initial release merging top browser automation skills into a unified framework.

- Automatically selects cloud or local browser environment based on available keys.
- Supports robust session management, including persistent profiles and connecting to existing tabs.
- Provides core browser automation commands: navigate, click, type, snapshot, screenshot, pdf export, and more.
- Enables advanced interactions: referencing elements, waiting, mouse control, drag-and-drop.
- Integrates best practices for reliability, including explicit waits and error handling.
- Combines features from six leading browser automation skills.
summary: Unified browser automation framework supporting local and cloud sessions with navigation, interaction, snapshots, profiles, and error handling.
